regime.label: Neutral dealer gamma on the 1080 seam while 1,452 call lots add only 81 OI and the put tail bid hits a 5-session high at 34 DTE
evidence: +3,318 baht/point of net dealer gamma sits within 20 points of spot 1075.3, yet cumulative GEX below spot is -5,760 and the flip holds 1100 for a 4th session: dealers damp the 1080-1100 block (+7,038) and amplify the 1030-1050 put shelf (-3,728), leaving price on the seam between the two.

1,452 call lots traded today converted into only +81 net call OI (5.6%) while the 1120 call IV fell 0.79 to 12.82 - volume without OI build and with IV falling is call supply, not demand, and it fails the Vol2Vol test for a genuine upside bid.

+438 put OI on 1,610 lots (27% conversion) lifted P/C OI to a fresh 2.15 high; put OI is +4,412 (+12.5%) over 5 sessions against +1,201 calls (+6.9%), so protection is still accumulating at 34 DTE rather than pinning into an expiry.

334 lots into the 1100 call wall (2,860 OI) and 149 into the 1050 put (1,663 OI) confirm both walls as live; the 910 put wall's 15,888 OI drew 4 lots at 165 points (15.3%) distance and fails Vol2Vol - structural floor, not active flow.

S50U26.today_summary: 1075.3 closed +2.4 for a second straight gain, 5.3 points above a max pain that has not moved off 1070 in eight sessions. ATM IV compressed 0.71 to 13.00%, a 6-session low, tightening the 1 sigma daily move to 8.81 points (0.82% of spot). 1,452 call lots converted into just +81 net call OI while 1,610 put lots added +438, lifting P/C OI to a fresh 2.15 high even as P/C volume fell to 1.11. Net dealer gamma is +3,318 baht/point within 20 points of spot but -5,760 cumulative below it, wedging price between the 1080 damping node (+2,523) and the 1050 amplification node (-1,398).
what_changed: Call flow doubled to 1,452 lots from 951 but added only 81 net OI, a 5.6% conversion, while the 1120 call IV dropped 0.79 to 12.82 - the entire steepening of the 10D skew to +3.65 came from calls cheapening, not puts richening (the 1020 put has held 16.47-16.48 for three sessions).
P/C volume ratio collapsed to 1.11 from 1.55, the lowest in four sessions, yet P/C OI ticked up to a fresh 2.15 high - today's flow was call-heavy but the standing book got more put-heavy.
ATM IV fell 0.71 to 13.00%, completing the round trip from the 14.44% spike on 8/24 back to the 12.99% level of 8/19; the 1 sigma move tightened to 8.81 points from 9.26.

Net GEX across the chain rose 41% to +5,536 baht/point on the 1100 call block, but the gamma flip held 1100 for a fourth session and the local +/-20-point window was flat at +3,318 vs +3,232 - the structure did not change, only the tails thickened.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Over 5 sessions from 8/19 the index has gone nowhere - 1072.8 to 1075.3, +2.5 points - while the option book grew 11% to 58,290 contracts, and that asymmetry is the story. Put OI added 4,412 (+12.5%) against 1,201 calls (+6.9%), pushing P/C OI from 2.04 to a fresh 2.15 high with max pain frozen at 1070 for all eight sessions. The call wall migrated 1080 to 1100 on 8/20 and the gamma flip followed 1110 to 1100 on 8/21, where both have held since; the 1100 strike absorbed +744 call OI, the largest single-strike build on the board. Net GEX nearly doubled from +2,931 to +5,536 baht/point, but every point of that sits above spot - below it the cumulative reading is -5,760 and unchanged in character. ATM IV round-tripped 12.99 to 14.44 to 13.00 while the 10D put skew steepened monotonically from +2.17 to +3.65, so the market paid up for tails while selling the body: a Protection build, not a pin.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1050 / 1020
strategies.rationale: 34 DTE in a Protection zone with ATM IV at a 6-session-low 13.00% makes downside insurance cheap, and 1050 is the deepest negative-gamma node on the board at -1,398 baht/point - the strike below which dealer hedging turns pro-cyclical and sells into the move toward 1030/1020.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit paid, capped; max value 30 points (1050 - 1020). The 1020 leg sold at 16.47 IV against the 1050 leg bought at 13.91 gives a 2.56 vol-point pickup from the skew.
strategies.invalidation: A sustained trade back above 1080, the +2,523 baht/point damping node, removes the acceleration path and the spread decays.

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1100 / 1120
strategies.rationale: 1100 sits 24.7 points away - a 2.8 sigma session at 8.81 points - and is simultaneously the live call wall (2,860 OI, 334 lots) and the gamma flip, above which cumulative gamma turns positive so upside decelerates rather than extends; today's 5.6% call OI conversion says the flow there is supply, not demand.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20 points (wing width) minus net credit received.
strategies.invalidation: A sustained close above 1100 with call OI building rather than churning - conversion above ~30% on rising volume would flip the read.

strategies.name: Put credit spread 1030 / 1010
strategies.rationale: The counter-read to the hedge above: if the eight-session 1070 max pain and the 1050 near-put wall hold, the 1030 put at 15.80 IV carries a 2.80 vol-point premium over the 13.00% ATM at 45 points (5.1 sigma) below spot - size small, because short-vol payoff is negative-skew, small frequent gains against rare large losses.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20 points (wing width) minus net credit received. Note the skew works against this structure: the 1010 wing is bought at 17.58 IV, above the 15.80 sold at 1030.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1050, the -1,398 baht/point amplification trigger, well before the 1030 short strike is tested.

S50U26.prediction: Base case is continued rotation in 1070-1085, with 1075.3 wedged between the 1080 damping node and a 1070 max pain that has not moved in eight sessions; at 8.81 points of 1 sigma, the 24.7-point trip to the 1100 wall requires a 2.8 sigma session. The bias tilts mildly defensive rather than bearish, because the standing book keeps adding puts (+4,412 in 5 sessions) while calls churn without building (5.6% OI conversion on 1,452 lots today). A sustained trade below 1050 invalidates the range read - that is the -1,398 baht/point node where dealer hedging turns pro-cyclical and sells into the break toward 1030/1020.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position sizing is implied. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so no share delivery ever forces hedging into expiry: the max-pain and wall mechanics above are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks, and the 1070 anchor is a tendency, not a magnet. Defined-risk is not risk-free - the capped max loss on every structure listed is a real outcome, and short-vol payoffs carry negative skew (small frequent gains, rare large losses), so survival comes from size rather than accuracy. Macro or news flow can override the option structure outright; at 34 DTE the gamma concentration that drives pinning has not yet formed.
